versions.changelog:
- Initial public release of Ruhui (如晦): an open-source, self-hosted, bilingual (Chinese + English) System 1 decision engine.
- Provides programmable common sense for tasks like routing, ranking, extraction, verification, moderation, and triage.
- Supports two backends: a recommended Qwen3.5 LoRA LLM model and a fast (~33 ms) 322M BERT encoder.
- Runs fully offline with no API key required.
- Returns structured, typed answers (choice/noul/score) with calibrated probabilities—no text generation or parsing.
- Easy integration pattern with examples for scripts and services; models downloadable from ModelScope or Hugging Face.
